name: navbar-menu
title: Navbar Menu
description: A compact rounded navigation with three word links. Hovering a link opens a panel beneath the bar, either with product rows showing screenshots or with a short column of sublinks.
use: A compact top navigation where each link needs a rich panel of previews or several sublinks.
avoid: Touch and keyboard use: the panels are hover-only and never open on tap or focus.
a11y: Menu labels are plain paragraphs opened by mouse enter, so keyboard and touch users cannot open the panels. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark, fully rounded pill holding three plain word links. Hovering one opens a black rounded panel below it with a thin light border, listing either two product rows with small screenshots or a short stack of text links.
behaves: Moving onto a link opens its panel, which scales and fades in with a spring and slides between links. Leaving the nav closes it, and links brighten slightly under the pointer.
customise: Compose Menu with MenuItem entries that take item, active and setActive, then put any panel content inside; colours and the spring are fixed in the source.
weight: light: A few nodes with one layout animation; nothing runs while closed.
demo: Design System and Analytics product rows with screenshots; Documentation, Changelog, Blog and Community links.
issues: Panels open on hover only, so touch and keyboard users cannot reach them.
Frame 2 shows the product screenshots as grey loading placeholders.
The bar sits high with a large empty area beneath until a panel opens.
polishWhy: Crisp dark pill and tidy panels; hover-only opening leaves touch and keyboard out.
